predictions.prediction_text: Rangebounding will continue to juice liquidity and suppress volatility, allowing market makers to manipulate bid/ask and potentially kick out long-vol positions.

predictions.prediction_text: Use ATM and ITM option legs when you expect a faster, more convex move, and OTM legs when you expect longer-term moves and cheaper exposure.
